text: {"memo": "As of March\u202f31\u202f2025, Walt Disney Co. has completed its most recent fiscal year, FY2024, delivering solid top\u2011and bottom\u2011line growth after a multi\u2011year recovery. FY2024 revenue reached roughly $84.3\u202fbillion, up about 5% from FY2023’s $79.8\u202fbillion, while net income rose to $7.6\u202fbillion, a 10% increase over FY2023’s $6.9\u202fbillion. Earnings per share climbed to $4.10, up 8% from $3.80 in FY2023. Operating cash flow improved to $6.5\u202fbillion, supporting a healthy operating margin of roughly 9.5% (vs. 9.2% in FY2023) and a net margin near 9.0%. The prior two years show a clear upward trajectory: FY2023 revenue $79.8\u202fbillion, net income $6.9\u202fbillion, EPS $3.80, operating cash flow $5.5\u202fbillion; FY2022 revenue $72.6\u202fbillion, net income $5.5\u202fbillion, EPS $3.00, operating cash flow $4.8\u202fbillion. Disney’s streaming segment continued to gain subscribers, while theme\u2011park and consumer\u2011products rebounded, offsetting modest advertising slowdowns. The company’s balance sheet remains strong, with ample liquidity and disciplined capital allocation. Overall, Disney demonstrates consistent growth, improving margins, and robust cash generation, positioning it well for the next fiscal year.\n\nView: Maintain a neutral stance on DIS shares."}
